summary: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market equity offering of common stock with an aggregate gross sales price of up to $900 million, of which approximately $270 million remains available after prior sales. The filing updates a November 2024 prospectus supplement and utilizes an equity distribution agreement with multiple managers and forward sale structures. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. The filing involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change.
